description: Reviewer testdata: the cancelled terminal contract, broken on its fourth condition. The task ends status=cancelled after its first (system-verified) step, the control binding is valid, the delivered step's outcome is resolved and the single surviving effect is explicitly allowed — every condition of the cancelled contract holds except the last one: the final speech claims 已完成并确认 of a task that ended cancelled. Claiming completion of a cancelled task is an overclaim, so the recorded pass is not supported and the reviewer must judge this package FAIL (exit code 1). It also shows why the overclaim criterion alone is not enough: the receipt does carry a system-verified basis for the delivered step, so the speech is licensed for that step but not for the cancelled task as a whole. Not product evidence — it only exercises the reviewer.
